title: The Bishop's Offer
text: A bishop of the Court offers absolution from a silk-hung chair, rings on every finger. Salvation has a price, he explains: a donation, and a name. Which House among you has sinned most? He already knows, he says. He only wants to hear you say it.

options.label: Name a rival House as the worst sinner, and let the Court look elsewhere.

outcomes.text: He writes it down in purple ink. The Court will look into it, he says, with a smile you will have to live with.

options.label: Donate, and name no one. Some sins are best left unspoken.

outcomes.text: With a wave of a ringed hand, every one of you is absolved. It feels better than it should, which worries you.

options.label: The wisest names his sins instead, and lets him hear how it feels.

outcomes.text: He goes white beneath his paint and lets you go very quickly. He will remember your faces.
